title: Active-fluidics versus gravity-fluidics system in phacoemulsification for type 2 diabetes mellitus without diabetic retinopathy: a retrospective observational study

license.statement: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 4.0 International License); not CC BY or CC0, so the record is private

indication: Type 2 diabetes mellitus without diabetic retinopathy, age-related cataract with Emery-Little nuclear grade III; glaucoma, uveitis, retinal disease, diabetic macular edema and previous intraocular surgery excluded; one eye per patient

groups.indication: Type 2 diabetes mellitus without diabetic retinopathy
groups.description: Phacoemulsification (Centurion, 2.4 mm clear corneal incision, torsional divide and conquer, in-the-bag IOL) with the Active Fluidics Control mode (target IOP 50 mmHg); allocation by system availability and surgeon preference; single surgeon

groups.indication: Type 2 diabetes mellitus without diabetic retinopathy
groups.description: Phacoemulsification (Centurion, 2.4 mm clear corneal incision, torsional divide and conquer, in-the-bag IOL) with gravity fluidics (bottle about 90 cm); allocation by system availability and surgeon preference; single surgeon

series.baseline_label: Baseline = preoperative ECD of the operated eye (Table 5 'ECD, cells/mm2' row 'Baseline')
series.notes: Table 5 column 'AFS group (n = 61)'; mean ± SD (Statistical analysis: continuous variables as mean ± standard deviation). 1 week post-op = 7/30.4375 months. Inclusion required complete follow-up data; per-visit n not tabulated.

series.baseline_label: Baseline = preoperative ECD of the operated eye (Table 5 'ECD, cells/mm2' row 'Baseline')
series.notes: Table 5 column 'GFS group (n = 44)'; mean ± SD (Statistical analysis: continuous variables as mean ± standard deviation). 1 week post-op = 7/30.4375 months. Inclusion required complete follow-up data; per-visit n not tabulated.

exclusions.reason: The same table gives absolute ECD for both groups; the absolute ECD series are used

exclusions.what: Table 5 'Mean differences (95% CI)', 't' and 'P value' columns
exclusions.reason: Between-group statistics and p-values are not admissible

notes: Active and gravity fluidics are two standard fluidics modes of the same commercial phaco platform, allocated by availability and surgeon preference without an investigational agent: both control-role, separate groups; type 2 diabetes is the condition of the whole cohort.
Only patients with complete follow-up data were included (Methods).
